description: Decisions on the user-switchable upstream switches that scripts/upstream_surface_watch.py observes (catalogs/foundation/upstream-surface-baseline.json). A new name whose key has no row here is unreviewed: the watch lists it in latest.json and scripts/currency_due.py counts it as surface_unreviewed. Validate with python3 scripts/upstream_surface_watch.py --check-dispositions; field rules: docs/upstream-surface-watch.md. Rows recorded 2026-10-04 from the review of the changelog-derived switches (Claude Code 2.1.289, Codex rust-v0.160.0): every judged switch, and every switch that a repository decision enabled or declined. Not recorded as rows, because they carry no decision: baseline switches whose upstream default already gives the wanted behavior (266), switches that do not apply to the hosts (181), and baseline switches with no changelog or release-note mention in the recent window (about 350); such a baseline name is grandfathered by the baseline itself. Generated by a deterministic script from the judged ledger; judgments were independently refuted, and adoptions are `adopt-pending` until a carrier applies them.

rules.key: surface:kind:name, for example claude:setting:autoUpdatesChannel. Any kind is allowed, because the judged ledger spans more kinds than the watch observes; each key appears once.
rules.enabled: Decided and applied: the carrier (file or profile) sets the value at the scope.
rules.adopt-pending: Decided but not yet applied: the carrier names where the value will be set.
rules.declined: Decided against: the reason says why and overturn names the comparison that would change it.
rules.default-on: The upstream default already gives the wanted behavior, so nothing is set; carrier may be null.
rules.not-applicable: Does not apply to this stack's hosts or workflows, such as another platform or a removed feature.
rules.defer-user: Needs the user's own decision (sign-in, spending, policy); the resolver does not apply it.
rules.baseline-unreviewed: Grandfathered at the baseline version without a judgment; like every row, it is excluded from the unreviewed count, and overturn may be null.
rules.unreviewed: A name absent from the baseline whose key has no row here. Only these are counted; a baseline name without a row is grandfathered by the baseline itself.
rules.fields: Every row has all ten fields: key; one of the seven values above; reason (one line, at most 160 characters); source (an https URL or path:line, repo@pin:path:line included); carrier (required for enabled and adopt-pending, otherwise a string or null); value (any JSON, null allowed); scope (a short string or null); overturn (required except for baseline-unreviewed); reviewed_utc (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ); version (the upstream version the review read).
